page.overview:
Who is Athudashionus?

Athudashionus is an ancient silver dragon and a guardian of the Platinum Sanctuary in Vasselheim. As an NPC, they are played by Matthew Mercer.

Athudashionus is a massive silver dragon who almost looks like a statue when not moving.

As an ancient dragon, Athudashionus was born at least eight centuries ago. A follower of the Platinum Dragon, as of 843 PD they had spent centuries as a protector and guardian of the Platinum Sanctuary in Vasselheim and the worshippers there.

After the apogee solstice of 843 PD Athudashionus was present in the Dawn City during an important meeting of the Exandrian Accord. The silver dragon stayed outside, watching the city. When Bells Hells and their friends were walking nearby, Athudashionus looked almost like a statue until the tail moved, surprising the adventurers.
